structure.count_authority_reason: This is the TATTVADARSHA RECENSION, COMPLETE IN ITS OWN TERMS -- corrected 2026-09-07; this field previously read 'adhyāyas 1-2 of the canonical 4 ... a sourcing gap', which presupposed one recension and was wrong. The edition closes at adhyāya 2 (...जैमिनिसूत्रतिलके द्वितीयाध्यायः समाप्तः) and its commentator argues that is the whole work: at offset 157,524 Sītārāma Śarmā writes इस अन्तिम सूत्र से स्पष्ट सिद्ध होता है कि महर्षि जैमिनि ने इस ग्रन्थ को दो अध्याय में ही समाप्त किया -- 'this final sūtra clearly establishes that Maharṣi Jaimini concluded this work in only two adhyāyas'. A RIVAL 4-adhyāya recension exists (Kṛṣṇānanda Sarasvatī / Nīlakaṇṭha manuscript tradition; K.V. Abhyankar's 1951 critical edition, staged in the sources tree, edits all four from 15 manuscripts). The two are DIFFERENT TEXTUAL TRADITIONS and their sūtra numbering must not be assumed to align -- do not append Abhyankar's 3-4 to this text without an explicit decision. Within the two adhyāyas held here all 8 pādas are present and colophon-bounded (7 explicit इति...पादः colophons plus the closing adhyāya colophon for the 8th); three individual sūtras (1.2.50, 2.1.31, 2.2.21) are absent from the source's own numbering and were not invented. A fourth apparent absence, 1.2.21, was recovered from a malformed marker -- see the script's module docstring.

shlokas.english_draft: We shall now expound the aphorisms of astrological instruction (Upadesa).
Signs aspect other signs situated opposite to them.
Also, movable signs aspect fixed signs adjacent to them (except the adjacent sign itself), and fixed signs aspect movable ones.
Planets situated in those signs also aspect in the same manner as the signs.
Argala (planetary intervention/obstruction) is formed by planets in the 4th, 2nd, and 11th houses from the aspected sign or planet.
A planet in the 3rd house also forms Argala, especially if malefic and numerous.
Planets in the 10th, 12th, and 9th houses obstruct (Virodhargala) the Argala formed by the 4th, 2nd, and 11th houses respectively.
The obstructing planets do not counteract the Argala if they are fewer in number or weaker.
In the 5th and 9th houses (Trikonas), Argala is also considered.
In the case of Ketu, the calculation of Argala and obstruction operates in the reverse order.
The planet that advances the highest degrees and minutes among the seven (or eight including Rahu) planets becomes the Atmakaraka.
The Atmakaraka rules over bondage and liberation of the soul.
The planet with the next highest degree after Atmakaraka becomes the Amatyakaraka (minister).
The planet with the next highest degree after Amatyakaraka becomes the Bhratrikaraka (brother).
The planet following Bhratrikaraka in degree becomes the Matrikaraka (mother).
The planet following Matrikaraka in degree becomes the Pitrikaraka (father).
The planet following Pitrikaraka in degree becomes the Putrakaraka (children).
The planet following Putrakaraka in degree becomes the Jnatikaraka (relatives/kinsmen).
The planet with the lowest degree becomes the Darakaraka (spouse).
Some authorities combine Matrikaraka and Putrakaraka into one, utilizing seven Karakas.
From the respective Karakas, sisters, brothers-in-law, younger siblings, and mother are determined.
Maternal uncles and other relatives are determined subsequently from the Matrikaraka.
Grandfathers, husband, and sons should be understood directly from the mouth of a qualified preceptor (Guru).
Parents-in-law, father-in-law, and maternal grandparents are learned by disciples.
Saturn is considered the elder/senior among planets.
In odd signs, counting proceeds in the direct (zodiacal/clockwise) order.
In even signs, counting proceeds in the reverse (anti-clockwise) order.
This reverse counting rule does not apply universally in all contexts.
Even signs are generally reckoned up to their ruling lords.
Repetition of sign counting occurs according to specific rules.
The Pada (Arudha) of a sign is as many signs distant from its lord as the lord is distant from that sign.
If the lord is in its own sign or 4th house, the Arudha (Pada) falls in the 10th or 4th house accordingly.
If the lord is in the 5th house, the Arudha falls in the 9th house.
Everywhere, houses and signs share identical characteristics and classifications.
Planets themselves do not possess sign-inherent Arudha properties.
Hora, Drekkana, and other divisional charts are established according to classical tradition.
Now begins the examination of Svamsha (the Navamsha occupied by Atmakaraka) of planets.
If the 5th from Svamsha is occupied by specific planets, fear or affliction from mice or cats is indicated.
Quadrupeds are indicated when four-legged signs or planets are present there.
In the 8th house from Svamsha, itchiness, skin disorders, or obesity are indicated.
In distant places, afflictions from water-borne diseases, leprosy, etc., occur.
The remaining positions indicate afflictions from wild beasts or predators.
Similar to the 8th house, the 7th house indicates fire sparks and perils.
In the 11th house from Svamsha, business, trade, and commercial gain are indicated.
Here, water creatures, reptiles, and loss of maternal milk/sustenance are indicated.
In even signs, fall from vehicles or high places occurs progressively.
In the 12th house (Rishpha), water creatures, birds, planet afflictions, itch, and malignant tumors are indicated.
In the 9th house (Dharma), construction of tanks, ponds, and charitable works are indicated.
If an exalted planet is in the 9th from Svamsha, constant righteousness and final liberation (Kaivalya) are attained.
If the Sun is situated there, the native is devoted to royal/government service.
If full Moon and Venus are there, the native is luxurious and lives by knowledge/learning.
If Mars is there, he becomes an alchemist/metallurgist, spear-bearer/warrior, or lives by fire.
If Mercury is there, merchants, weavers, artisans, and legal experts are produced.
If Jupiter is there, one devoted to rituals, supreme knowledge, and Vedic scholarship is produced.
If Venus is there, royal officials, passionate individuals, and those living to a hundred years/sensualists are produced.
If Saturn is there, the native lives by well-known or traditional occupations.
If Rahu is there, archers, thieves, physicians treating snakebites, and iron machinery workers are produced.
If Ketu is there, elephant dealers and thieves are indicated.
If Sun and Rahu are present, death occurs from snakebite.
If aspected by a benefic planet, that danger is neutralized.
If connected exclusively with benefics, the native becomes a physician skilled in anti-venom treatment.
If aspected solely by Mars, the native causes house-burning or becomes an arsonist.
If aspected by Venus, no house-burning takes place.
If aspected by Jupiter, the fire is confined to nearby houses without destroying one's own.
If associated with Gulika, the native gives poison to others or dies of poison.
If aspected by the Moon, his wealth is stolen by thieves, or he himself becomes a thief.
If aspected solely by Mercury, the native suffers from hydrocele/scrotal enlargement.

shlokas.text: तत्र केतौ पापदृष्टे कर्णच्छेदः कर्णरोगो वा
shlokas.english_draft: If Ketu there is aspected by a malefic, cutting of ears or ear disease occurs.
If aspected by Mercury and Venus, the native becomes an initiated priest (Dikshita).
If aspected by Mercury and Saturn, the native becomes impotent or lacking vigor.
If aspected by Mercury and Venus, he is born of a remarried woman or a maidservant.
If aspected by Saturn, he becomes an ascetic or a servant.
If aspected solely by Saturn, he takes up false/pseudo sannyasa.
If aspected by Sun and Venus there, he becomes a royal servant.
If Mercury is in the 12th or aspects the 12th, effects are like Saturn.
If aspected by benefics, stability and firm stay are maintained.
If Sun is aspected solely by Jupiter, he becomes a cowherd/cattle rearer.
If Moon and Venus aspect or combine in the 4th house from Svamsha, a palatial mansion is owned.
Similarly if an exalted planet occupies that house, a grand residence is gained.
Rahu and Saturn in the 4th give a stone-built house.
Mars and Ketu in the 4th give a brick-built house.
Jupiter in the 4th gives a wooden house.
The Sun in the 4th gives a thatched or straw hut.
If benefics aspect or combine in even houses, one is constant in virtue, truthful, and devoted to preceptors.
Otherwise, with malefics, contrary evil results occur.
Saturn and Rahu cause betrayal of Guru, while two Gurus (Jupiter/Venus) cause lack of faith in preceptors.
In the vargas of Venus and Mars, the native becomes an adulterer.
If aspected or combined with many malefics, illicit passion continues till death.
Ketu causes restriction or impediment.
Jupiter makes one devoted to or dominated by women.
Rahu causes loss of wealth or cessation of financial pursuits.
In the 11th or 7th house, Moon and Jupiter give a beautiful wife.
Rahu there gives a widowed or degraded woman.
Saturn there gives an older, diseased, or ascetic woman.
Mars gives a wife with defective or deformed limbs.
The Sun gives a woman guarded within her own family.
Mercury gives an accomplished and artistic wife.
Moon in Sagittarius causes union or residence in an open, uncovered place.
A malefic in the 3rd house from Svamsha makes the native courageous and valiant.
A benefic in the 3rd house makes the native timid or fearful.
Malefics in the 3rd and 6th houses make one an agriculturist or hard worker.
Especially when Jupiter is in an even sign in those houses.
An exalted benefic in the 12th house ensures attainment of auspicious higher realms after death.
Ketu in the 12th house from Svamsha bestows Kaivalya (final spiritual liberation).
Especially if Ketu is in Aries or Sagittarius in the 12th house.
Malefics in the 12th house indicate rebirth in lower or sorrowful realms.
Sun and Ketu in the 12th give devotion to Lord Shiva.
The Moon gives devotion to Goddess Gauri.
Venus gives devotion to Goddess Lakshmi.
Mars gives devotion to Lord Skanda (Kartikeya).
Mercury and Saturn give devotion to Lord Vishnu.
Jupiter gives devotion to Lord Sambasiva.
Rahu gives devotion to Tamasic deities and Goddess Durga.
Ketu gives devotion to Lord Ganesha and Skanda.
Saturn in a malefic sign gives devotion to lesser or evil spirits.
Venus in a malefic sign also incline towards lesser deities or tantric arts.
Similar devotions apply when examining Amatyakaraka and 6th house.
Two malefics in Trikona (5th/9th) make one a practitioner of mantras (Mantrika).
If aspected by malefics, he uses mantras for harm or control (Nigrahaka).
If aspected by benefics, he uses mantras for blessing and healing (Anugrahaka).
If Venus and Moon are aspected by Venus, the native becomes an alchemist (Rasavadi).
If aspected by Mercury, he becomes a physician (Bhisak).
Moon in Sagittarius aspected by Venus causes jaundice or leucoderma.
If aspected by Mars, major chronic diseases occur.
If aspected by Ketu, black/blue leprosy is indicated.
Mars and Rahu in the 4th/8th house cause consumption or tuberculosis.
If aspected by Moon, this consumption occurs without doubt.
Mars causes boils, carbuncles, and skin eruptions.
Ketu causes sprue/dysentery or water-borne disease.
Rahu and Gulika cause affliction from subtle poisons.
Saturn in the 4th from Svamsha makes one an archer or bowman.
Ketu makes one a clockmaker or maker of water-clocks.
Mercury makes one a Paramahamsa ascetic or a staff-bearing mendicant.
Rahu makes one a worker of iron machinery.
The Sun makes one a swordsman.
Mars makes one a spearman.
Moon and Jupiter in the 5th from Svamsha make one an author of books.
Venus makes one a author of slightly lesser renown.
Mercury makes an author of even moderate stature.
Venus in 5th makes one a poet, eloquent orator, and scholar of literature.
Jupiter makes one an all-knowing scholar and composer of classical texts.
Though an author, he may not necessarily be an eloquent speaker.
Specifically, Jupiter makes one a grammarian and scholar of Veda and Vedanta.
Saturn in 5th causes hesitation or dullness in public assemblies.
Mercury in 5th makes one a Mimamsaka philosopher.
Mars in 5th makes one a Naiyayika (logician).
The Moon makes one learned in Samkhya, Yoga, literature, and music/singing.
The Sun makes one learned in Vedanta and music.
Ketu in 5th makes one a mathematician.
Connection of Jupiter ensures mastery of traditional lineage (Sampradaya).
Similar results are evaluated from the 9th house (Bhagya).
Some authorities apply these rules continuously in all contexts.
Ketu in 9th aspected by a malefic makes speech rigid or stammering.
Equal malefics in 9th and 3rd from Pitripada cause Kemadruma yoga.
Especially if aspected by the Moon.
This poverty/Kemadruma yoga operates during planetary periods (Dasa) of all involved.
Now begins the determination of Pada (Arudha Lagna).
If the 12th from Arudha Lagna has planets or is aspected by planets, the native becomes wealthy.
Benefics in the 11th from Arudha Lagna bring wealth through righteous means.
Malefics bring gain through unrighteous or questionable means.
Exalted planets in the 11th bring immense wealth.
Debilitated planets aspected or joined cause excessive expenditure over income.
Sun, Rahu, and Venus in 11th give wealth through royal/government sources.
If aspected by the Moon, this royal wealth is certain.
Mercury gives wealth through relatives or litigation.
Jupiter gives wealth from taxes, banking, or religious sources.
Mars and Saturn give wealth through brothers or hard labor.
Similar sources apply to expenditure when these planets are in the 12th from Arudha.
Rahu and Ketu in 2nd/11th from Arudha cause abdominal ailments.
Ketu causes sudden loss of signs of wealth or physical vigor.
Moon, Jupiter, and Venus in 2nd/11th from Arudha make one extremely wealthy.
An exalted planet there also confers great prosperity.
Other effects are generally evaluated similar to Svamsha.
If the Arudha of 11th house (Labhapada) is in Kendra or Trikona from Lagna Arudha, wealth is assured.
Otherwise, if in 6th, 8th, or 12th (Dusthana), poverty occurs.
Placements in Kendra, Trikona, or Upachaya foster mutual friendship between lords.
Placements in 6th, 8th, or 12th foster enmity and conflict.
Arudha of 7th and 11th houses with unobstructive Argala brings fortune and marriage.
Benefic Argala brings abundance of wealth.
If Ghatika Lagna and Arudha are aspected by the same planet, kings/rulers are produced.
Similar royal yogas form from 7th/11th in Rasi, Navamsha, or Drekkana.
If one of these factors is lacking, the royal status is diminished accordingly.
Likewise evaluate from Navamsha and Drekkana charts.
If Moon and aspecting planets are in Leo or aspect each other, carriage/vehicle ownership is indicated.
Venus, Mars, and Ketu together indicate religious canopy, flags, or royal insignias.
Benefics in even houses in 1st, 9th, 7th, and 4th make one a ruler.
Malefics in 10th and 6th from Arudha also contribute to ruling power.
Evaluate similarly from the lord of 9th and 11th houses.
Mixed planets produce moderate or medium results.
Contrary placements produce poverty (Daridra yoga).

shlokas.text: मातरि गुरौ शुक्रे चन्द्रे वा राजकीयाः
shlokas.english_draft: Jupiter, Venus, or Moon in the 4th from Arudha produce royal officers.
A malefic in 10th or 6th makes one an army commander.
Aspect of benefics on these houses makes one intelligent and wise.
Aspect of 7th lord brings happiness and marital bliss.
Aspect of 6th lord brings poverty and sickness.
Aspect of 8th/12th lord brings extravagant expenditure.
Aspect of the house lord makes the house strong and powerful.
Combinations of 5th/9th and 6th/7th lords cause specific bondage or release.

shlokas.text: एवमृक्षाणां तदीशानां च शुभ-सम्बन्धे निरोधमात्रं पापसम्बन्धाच्छृङ्खलाप्रहारादयः
shlokas.english_draft: Benefic links cause mere house arrest, while malefic links bring chains and beatings.
Rahu in 2nd from Venus aspected by Sun causes blindness or eye injury.
The Moon gives musical instruments and royal insignias.
Upapada (Upapada Lagna) is the Arudha of the 12th house from Lagna.

shlokas.text: तत्र पापस्य पापयोगे प्रव्रज्या दारनाशौ वा
shlokas.english_draft: Malefic in Upapada joined by malefic causes renunciation (Pravrajya) or loss of spouse.
Here, the Sun is not considered a destructive malefic.
If aspected by or joined with benefics, loss of spouse does not occur.
Debilitated planet in Upapada causes loss of wife.
Exalted planet in Upapada gives multiple wives or a noble wife.
Dual sign in Upapada also indicates more than one wife.

shlokas.text: तत्र स्वामियुक्ते स्वर्क्षे वा तद्धेतावुत्तरायुषि निर्दारः
shlokas.english_draft: If lord of Upapada is in own sign or joined, loss of wife may occur late in life.
If Upapada lord is exalted, marriage takes place into a high family.
If debilitated, marriage takes place into a low or degraded family.
Connection with benefics gives a charming and beautiful spouse.
Rahu and Saturn cause desertion or death of spouse through scandal.
Ketu in Upapada causes menorrhagia/bleeding disorders to the wife.
Mercury and Ketu cause bone-flux or discharge diseases.
Saturn, Sun, and Rahu cause bone fever.
Mercury and Ketu cause corpulence/obesity.
Saturn and Mars in Mercury's sign cause nasal diseases.
Similarly in Mars's sign.
Jupiter and Saturn cause ear disease or defect.
Jupiter and Rahu cause dental diseases.
Saturn and Rahu in Virgo/Libra cause lameness or chronic disease.
Benefic aspects or conjunctions mitigate these diseases.
Evaluate children similarly from the 7th house from Upapada or Saptamsha.
Venus in 2nd from Upapada causes childlessness.
Sun, Rahu, and Jupiter in 2nd from Upapada give many sons.
The Moon gives an only son.
Mixed planets cause delay in obtaining children.
Mars and Saturn give an adopted son.
Odd sign in 2nd from Upapada gives many sons.
Even sign gives few children or female progeny.
Determine child characteristics from planetary nature.
Saturn and Rahu in 3rd/11th from Upapada cause loss of siblings.
Venus causes miscarriage or gap between pregnancies.
Similarly in 9th house when aspected by Venus.
Mars, Jupiter, Moon, and Mercury give many siblings.
Saturn and Mars aspecting cause loss of brothers.
Saturn leaves only the native surviving among siblings.
Ketu in 3rd/11th gives a large number of sisters.
Rahu in 9th from 11th lord gives prominent teeth.
Ketu there makes speech stammering or mute.
Saturn there makes one ugly or deformed.
Planets determine complexions such as yellow, fair, or dark.
From the 2nd from Amatyakaraka, devotion to specific deities is judged.
Only malefic connection with Svamsha indicates illegitimate birth.
A single malefic does not confirm illegitimate birth.
Saturn and Rahu together bring public fame.
Other planets cause concealment or privacy.
If in benefic vargas, it results only in false rumor/allegation.
Two planets in Svamsha make the native the head of his family.
Longevity is determined from Lagna, Hora Lagna, and lords of 8th/1st.
Movable-Movable or Fixed-Dual pairs indicate Long Life (Dirghayu).
Movable-Fixed or Dual-Dual pairs indicate Medium Life (Madhyayu).
Fixed-Fixed or Movable-Dual pairs indicate Short Life (Alpayu).
Similarly evaluate longevity from Saturn and the Moon.
Also evaluate from Lagna and Atmakaraka.
When two or three methods agree, the longevity estimate is authoritative.
In case of disagreement, rely on the Lagna and Atmakaraka method.
If Moon is in 1st/7th, rely on Moon and Saturn method.
If Saturn is a longevity factor, Kakshya Hrasa (reduction of longevity tier) occurs.
Others hold that Saturn's role produces Kakshya Vriddhi (increase).
Reduction does not occur if Saturn is in own sign or exalted.
Nor does it occur if Saturn is aspected only by malefics.
If Jupiter is in 1st/7th aspected only by benefics, Kakshya Vriddhi (increase) occurs.

shlokas.text: मलिने द्वारबाह्ये नवांशे निधनं, द्वारद्वारेशयोश्च मालिन्ये
shlokas.english_draft: Afflicted Navamsha of Dvara/Bahya signs causes death during their Dasa.
Aspect or conjunction of benefics prevents premature death.
If 8th lord is exalted, addition of Navamsha years (Vriddhi) takes place.
Death occurs at end of Padasa Dasa, Pada-Navamsha Dasa, or Trikona from Sun/Lagna.
Longevity triad operates based on strength of Lagna, 8th lord, and Kendra placements.
Even signs invert the calculation order.
Strength is derived from sign characteristics.

shlokas.text: रोगेशयोः स्वत ऐक्ये योगे वा मध्यम्
shlokas.english_draft: Conjunction or identity of Lagna lord and 8th lord gives Medium life.
Reduction applies when afflicted.
Apply same rules to self/Lagna.
Malefic, debilitated, non-exalted planet causes reduction.
Benefic exalted planet gives increase.
Jupiter adds longevity.
Full Moon and Venus increase longevity by one sign period.
Saturn produces the opposite effect.
In Sthira Dasa, death occurs according to the longevity compartment (Alpa/Madhya/Dirgha).
Lagna or 8th hemmed between malefics, or malefics in Trikonas/6th/8th cause death.
Lords aspected solely by waning Moon and Venus cause death.
Death occurs in Navamsha of 8th lord from Lagna.
The stronger lord of 2nd or 8th house is designated as Rudra.
Even the weaker planet becomes Rudra if aspected by malefics.
If Rudra is aspected by benefics, life extends to the end of Shoola Dasa.
Benefic conjunction further protects.
Malefic conjunction excluding Sun does not protect.

shlokas.text: मन्दारेन्दुदृष्टे शुभयोगाभावे, पापयोगेऽपि वा शुभदृष्टौ वा परतः
shlokas.english_draft: Saturn, Mars, Moon aspecting without benefic yoga causes death in subsequent Dasa.
Death occurs in the sub-period of Shoola Dasa.
Generally in the sign occupied by Rudra.
Especially if Aries is the 9th house (father).
Dual sign Rudra brings death at the end of that period.
Death falls in 1st, 2nd, or 3rd part of Dasa according to longevity category.
Maheswara planet is the lord of 8th from Atmakaraka.
If 8th lord is exalted/own sign, 8th from 8th (3rd lord) becomes Maheswara.

shlokas.text: पाताभ्यां योगे स्वस्य तयोर्वा रोगे ततः
shlokas.english_draft: Rahu/Ketu conjunction alters Maheswara to 6th lord.
Brahma planet is determined as the strongest among lords of 1st, 7th, 8th in odd signs.
If Saturn, Rahu, or Ketu becomes Brahma, the next planet is chosen.
If multiple candidates exist, the one sharing same gender/nature is selected.
Rahu conjunction reverses selection.
Brahma must be situated in a valid house.
In dispute, the planet with higher degree/strength wins.
Longevity extends from Brahma Dasa to Maheswara Dasa.
Death occurs in the year of Trikona sign from Maheswara.
Strongest lord among 1st, 10th, 5th, 8th becomes Maraka (killer).
The 5th lord often acts as Maraka.
Death occurs in the Dasa of that sign.
Death occurs in antardasa of 6th, 8th, or 5th lord.
Stronger of Sun and Venus represents the father.
Stronger of Moon and Mars represents the mother.
Weaker planet aspected by malefic also acts.
Shoola Dasa of parent factor causes death of parents.
Others judge from Shoola Dasa of 9th/4th lord.
Other longevity principles apply similarly.
Sun-Mercury in Aries Lagna Dasa causes death of father.
Parent factors aspected only by non-Sun malefics cause death before 12 years.
Jupiter's Shoola Dasa causes death of spouse.
Respective Shoola Dasas cause death of respective relatives.
Malefic in 3rd from Lagna/Arudha causes unnatural/painful death.
Benefic in 3rd causes peaceful/holy death.
Mixed planets cause mixed death conditions.
Sun causes death due to royal/government punishment or fire.
Moon causes death due to consumption or pulmonary disease.
Mars causes death from wounds, weapons, fire, or operations.
Saturn causes death from vata (rheumatic/paralytic) disorders or starvation.
Saturn and Mandi cause death from poison, snakes, drowning, or hanging.
Ketu causes death from cholera, diarrhea, or water-borne disease.
Moon and Mandi cause sudden death from food poisoning or choking.
Jupiter causes death from swelling/dropsy; Venus causes death from diabetes/kidney disease.
Mixed planets give combined causes of death.
Conjunction or aspect of Moon confirms the cause of death.
Benefics in 3rd cause death in a holy or clean place.
Malefics cause death in an unholy or degraded place (Kikata).
Jupiter and Venus cause conscious and peaceful departure.
Other planets cause unconscious or distressed death.
Ketu in 3rd prevents performing final funeral rites for parents.
Lagna in first half of Leo etc. affects father first; second half affects mother.
Benefic aspect prevents loss of ability to perform rites.
In odd signs, Navamsha calculation begins from the sign itself.
In even signs, Navamsha calculation begins from the 9th sign therefrom.
Years of Sthira Dasa are 7, 8, 9 for Movable, Fixed, Dual signs.
Sthira Dasa begins from the sign occupied by Brahma.
Now the calculation of Prana Dasa is explained.
Sign occupied by Karaka becomes first Dasa.
If equal, sign with more planets is stronger.
Next, sign with exalted planet is stronger.
Next, natural strength of signs applies.
In absence, lord's status determines strength.
Atmakaraka gives special strength.
Adjoining signs apply in male charts.
Thus ends the first strength rule.
Aspect or conjunction of Lord, Jupiter, Mercury gives second strength.
Lord's placement gives third strength.
Lord in Kendra, Panaphara, Apoklima from own sign determines relative weakness.
Fourth strength rule applies to male nativity.
Shoola Dasa begins from 1st or 7th house, whichever is stronger.
For father's death, Shoola Dasa begins from 9th or 3rd house.
For mother's death, Shoola Dasa begins from 4th or 10th house.
For brother's death, Shoola Dasa begins from 3rd or 9th house.
For sister and son, Shoola Dasa begins from 11th or 5th house.
For elder brother, Shoola Dasa begins from 11th house.
Paternal relatives are evaluated like father.
Maternal relatives are evaluated like mother.
Dasa periods run in direct order for male signs.
Exchange of signs alters Dasa sequence.
Conjunction/aspect of malefics modifies results.
Conjunction with exalted planets enhances Dasa.
Thus are the four Dasa systems defined.
In Chara Dasa, 5th house calculation determines direct or reverse Dasa order.
In this system, Ketu acts as a benefic.
Second house strength is evaluated in Chara Navamsha.
Sign of Dasa lord acts as Dvara (door) sign.
Sign as far distant from Dvara as Dvara is from Lagna becomes Bahya (exterior).
Malefics in Dvara and Bahya cause imprisonment or bondage.
If lord is in own sign, imprisonment does not occur.
All effects of signs and planetary combinations apply here.
Calculation starts from the stronger of 1st or 7th house.
First Dasa runs direct or reverse based on sign oddity.
Second Dasa system counts from the Sun.
Third Dasa counts in quadruplicities (Kendra/Panaphara/Apoklima).
Navamsha lords in Kendras determine Dasa order.
Strength relies on oddity and Kendra placement from Lagna.
Dasa cycle repeats through 1st and 11th houses.
Results of planetary strength are interpreted as before.
Manduka Dasa uses leap-counting across odd/even signs.
Results of Shoola Dasa indicate death, loss, or gain.
Male signs run equal Dasa years generally.
